blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) matches natural language descriptions against databases of geo-tagged reference images, enabling localization without visual queries. Despite its potential for language-guided navigation, existing vision-language models lag far behind visual place recognition (VPR) baselines, even after task adaptation. Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, place recognition relies on subtle local cues to distinguish visually similar locations. We therefore hypothesize that a primary bottleneck in CMPR is capturing fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text details, which requires higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. To address this challenge, we propose CrossPlace, a two-stage CMPR framework. Stage 1 performs global retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder, while Stage 2 refines top candidates using a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker. Through systematic analysis, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy and show that visual token density provides the largest performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and task fine-tuning offer complementary gains. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we also extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale and severe weather and illumination settings. Across all existing and new benchmarks, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal methods, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR. Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace
blocks.zh: 跨模式位置识别(CMPR)与地理标记参考图像数据库的自然语言描述相匹配,使得无需视觉查询即可本地化. 尽管具有语言引导导航的潜力,但现有的视觉语言模型远远落后于视觉位置识别(VPR)基线,即使在任务调整后也是如此. 与通用文本到图像检索不同,位置识别依赖于微妙的局部提示来区分视觉相近的位置. 因此,我们假设,CMPR中的一个主要瓶颈正在捕捉图像区域与文本细节之间的精细对应,这需要更高的视觉符号颗粒性、强大的文本代表能力以及本地的跨模式匹配。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议跨平台,即《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议的两个阶段框架。 第1阶段通过将一个联合对齐的DINOv2-B/14视觉主干线与一个逐渐微调的BGE-Large文本编码器进行配对来进行全局检索,而第2阶段则使用轻量级的代号级交叉取号来完善顶级候选者. 通过系统分析,我们隔离了检索精度的驱动力,并表明视觉符号密度提供了最大的性能改进,而文本编码器能力和任务微调则提供了互补收益. 为了在现实条件下评价稳健性,我们还将《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议评价范围扩大到城市规模和恶劣天气及照明环境。 在所有现有的和新的基准中,CrossPlace实现两位数Recall@1比以往的交叉模式方法改进,将差距缩小到单模式文本检索,并缩小到单模式 VPR。 守则和基准见https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual place recognition (VPR) matches visual queries against geo-localized image databases for global relocalization across diverse applications [ 35 , 22 ] . Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR), introduced by LaVPR [ 13 ] , extends this task to natural language, retrieving geographic locations purely from textual descriptions without an input image.
blocks.zh: 视觉位置识别(VPR)匹配了对地理定位图像数据库的可视化查询,用于不同应用程序的全球再定位[35,22]. LaVPR[13]引入的跨模式地位识别(CMPR)将这项任务延伸至自然语言,从文字描述中取回完全没有输入图像的地理位置.

blocks.en: CMPR addresses a fundamental operational gap. For example, in search-and-rescue operations, first responders verbally describe observed landmarks that must be geolocated immediately. Similarly, human-in-the-loop navigation requires operators to direct autonomous systems through language when camera feeds are unavailable. More broadly, text queries offer unique flexibility when image acquisition is corrupted, physically impossible, or operationally impractical, conditions that fundamentally limit or break standard VPR pipelines.
blocks.zh: 《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议处理了一个基本的业务缺口。 例如,在搜索和救援行动中,第一反应者口头描述了观测到的地标,这些地标必须立即定位。 同样地,人行即时导航要求操作者在没有相机种子时通过语言来引导自主系统. 更广泛地说,当图像获取被破坏、物理上不可能或操作上不切实际时,文本查询提供了独特的灵活性,这些条件从根本上限制了或打破标准的VPR管道。

blocks.en:
Despite the promise of cross-modal localization, language-to-image retrieval substantially trails unimodal visual place recognition. For example, on the MSLS-Val benchmark [ 38 ] , the best-performing cross-modal method (LaVPR [ 13 ] ) achieves a Recall@1 of 38.0 % 38.0\% , whereas state-of-the-art vision-only models exceed 85 % 85\% [ 22 , 14 ] .
Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, which focuses on coarse semantic categories, place recognition distinguishes specific locations through subtle local cues, such as door styles, window shapes, and facade textures, and their spatial layout within the scene.
blocks.zh:
尽管有望实现跨模式本地化,但从语言到图像的检索却大大跟踪单模式视觉地点的识别。 例如,在MSLS-Val基准 [38] 上,最佳表现的交叉模式方法(LaVPR [13])实现了38.0%38.0==1的召回,而最先进的唯能视模型则超过了85%85=[22,14].
与注重粗糙语义分类的通用文本到图像检索不同,放置识别通过细微的局部提示区分出具体位置,如出门样式,出窗外形,外观纹理等,以及场内空间布局.

blocks.en: We propose CrossPlace , a two-stage CMPR framework designed to address this challenge through higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. In Stage 1, CrossPlace performs global candidate retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder. In Stage 2, inspired by spatial reranking in visual place recognition [ 36 ] , we employ a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker over text tokens and local image patches to refine candidate scores.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CrossPlace,一个两阶段的CMPR框架,旨在通过更高的视觉标志颗粒性,强大的文本代表能力,以及当地的跨模式匹配来应对这一挑战. 在第一阶段,CrossPlace通过将一个联合配对的DINOv2-B/14视觉主干线与一个逐渐微调的BGE-Large文本编码器对齐,进行全局候选检索. 在第2阶段,在视觉位置识别的空间再排位[36]的启发下,我们使用轻量级的指使级交叉指使级再排位器来比文本指使和本地的图像补丁来完善候选分数.

blocks.en: Through systematic analysis of CrossPlace and alternative configurations, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy in practice. Our investigation shows that visual token density (spatial patch granularity) is the primary source of performance gains: increasing patch density from 49 49 tokens in ViT-B/32 to 256 256 in DINOv2-B/14 yields the largest performance improvement across all benchmarks, further reinforced by self-supervised spatial representations. Meanwhile, text encoder capacity and progressive task fine-tuning provide complementary, supporting gains once sufficient visual granularity is established. Furthermore, because CrossPlace matches or closely approaches the unimodal text-to-text retrieval reference ( Fig. 1 , dotted cyan line), these findings suggest that global cross-modal alignment is a secondary bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 通过对CrossPlace和替代配置的系统分析,我们在实践中孤立了检索准确性的驱动因素. 我们的调查显示,视觉信号密度(空间补丁颗粒性)是性能增益的主要来源:将补丁密度从Vit-B/32的49个信号增加至DINov2-B/14的256 256个,这是所有基准中最大的性能改进,并得到了自我监督的空间表现的进一步强化。 同时,文本编码器容量和渐进任务微调,一旦建立了足够的可视颗粒性,就提供了互补的支持收益. 而且,因为克罗斯 这些调查结果表明,全球跨模式对接是一个次要瓶颈。

blocks.en: To establish a broader benchmark suite and assess scalability and domain generalization, we evaluate our approach on established LaVPR benchmarks and introduce new cross-modal benchmarks derived from San Francisco eXtra Large (SF-XL) and SVOX. Across these diverse settings, our global retrieval stage alone substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Recall@1 by 5.2 ​ – ​ 20.3 5.2\text{--}20.3 percentage points (pp). Incorporating our lightweight cross-attention reranking module yields an overall improvement of 9.7 ​ – ​ 32.4 9.7\text{--}32.4 pp over prior cross-modal state of the art across all benchmarks, while introducing negligible latency. Moreover, CrossPlace narrows the gap to unimodal VPR baselines ( Fig. 1 , dashed orange line).
blocks.zh: 为了建立一个更广泛的基准套件,评估可扩展性和域通化性,我们评价我们关于既定的LaVPR基准的方法,并采用从旧金山eXtra Large(SF-XL)和SVOX衍生出的新跨模式基准。 通过这些不同的环境,仅仅我们的全球检索阶段就大大超过现有基线,使回调@1提高5.2 – 20.3 5.2\text{-}20.3个百分点(pp)。 将我们的轻量级交叉式重排模块纳入,比以前所有基准的跨模式技术水平总体改进了9.7-32.4-9.7\text{-}32.4页,同时引入了微不足道的延迟。 还有克罗斯 将空白缩小到单式VPR基线(图1,破折橙线)。

blocks.en: In summary, our key contributions are as follows: • We propose CrossPlace , a two-stage CMPR framework designed to capture fine-grained image–text correspondences, pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder in Stage 1, followed by a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker in Stage 2. • Through systematic architectural analysis, we pinpoint the drivers of CMPR accuracy, showing that visual token density is the primary source of performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and progressive task alignment provide complementary gains, effectively closing the gap to unimodal text retrieval. • We extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale (SF-XL) and severe weather and illumination (SVOX) settings, demonstrating that CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal baselines across all existing and new benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出CrossPlace,一个两阶段的CMPR框架,旨在捕捉精细的图像-文本对应,将一个联合对齐的DINOv2-B/14视觉主干线与一个逐步微调的BGE-Large文本编码器在第一阶段配对,然后在阶段中安装一个轻量级的符号级交叉重排键 2. 通过系统的建筑分析,我们确定了CMPR精确度的驱动因素,表明视觉符号密度是改进性能的主要来源,而文本编码器能力和渐进的任务调整提供了互补的收益,有效地缩小了单式文本检索的差距。 我们把《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议评价的范围扩大到城市规模(SF-XL)和恶劣天气和照明(SVOX)环境,表明跨地点比以往跨模式基线在所有现有和新的基准上都实现了两位数的回调。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Place Recognition
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉场所识别

blocks.en:
Visual place recognition (VPR) identifies the location of a query image by retrieving nearest matches from a geo-tagged database. Global descriptors are typically formed via pooling layers such as NetVLAD [ 3 ] or GeM [ 29 ] , with recent efforts boosting discriminability through optimal transport [ 14 ] , feature fusion [ 2 , 22 ] and foundation model adaptation [ 23 , 36 ] . Training objectives primarily rely on the contrastive multi-similarity loss [ 1 , 37 ] to enforce condition invariance, or classification proxies [ 5 , 6 ] .
Despite their effectiveness, image-only place recognition fails whenever query images cannot be acquired due to sensor failure, severe visual degradation [ 38 , 35 ] , or human-in-the-loop operation, motivating cross-modal paradigms that localize places directly from descriptive language queries [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
Visual place recognition (VPR) 通过从地理标记数据库中检索最近的匹配,来识别查询图像的位置. 全球描述词一般通过集成层形成,如NetVLAD[3]或GEM[29]等,最近的努力通过优化运输[14],特征聚变[2,22]和基础模型适应[23,36]来增强可区分性. 培训目标主要依靠相对应的多同异性损失[1,37],强制执行条件变化,或分类代词[5,6]。
尽管效果良好,但当由于传感器故障,严重视觉退化[38,35],或人-在-在-在-在-在-在-在操作时无法获取查询图像时,仅图像-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-操作,激发出从描述性语言查询直接将地方本地化的跨模式[13].

blocks.en: 2.2 Cross-Modal Place Recognition (CMPR)
blocks.zh: 2.2 跨山地识别

blocks.en: While standard visual localization typically operates in a unimodal mode, related efforts explore heterogeneous inputs. One line of work examines multimodal fusion, combining 2D imagery with 3D LiDAR point clouds [ 28 , 17 , 18 , 11 ] , or augmenting visual queries with extracted scene text [ 9 ] , descriptive language [ 13 ] , and multi-sensor streams [ 25 ] . Unified architectures like UniLoc [ 39 ] further support diverse query modalities mapped against 3D submaps. Other formulations address text-to-3D localization [ 16 , 40 , 21 , 42 ] by mapping descriptions directly to 3D point cloud coordinates, or match text against overhead satellite and map tiles [ 44 ] , diverging from scalable street-level visual databases. Recent cross-modal geo-localization methods also explore multi-anchor projection similarity for geometric alignment [ 12 ] , multi-view text-vision registration [ 33 ] , and semantic-anchored multi-view foundation models bridging images and text for geo-localization [ 34 ] . These formulations rely on multi-view imagery or specialized geometric anchors, and do not apply directly to standard text-to-image place recognition or its established benchmarks [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然标准视觉本地化一般以单一模式运作,但相关工作探索了各种不同的投入。 一行工作审查多式聚变,将2D成像与3D LiDAR点云[28,17,18,11]相融合,或用取出场景文本[9],描述语言[13],多传感器流[25]来增强视觉查询. UniLoc [39] 等统一架构进一步支持以3D子地图映射出的各种查询模式. 其它配方通过将描述直接映射到3D点云坐标,或将文本与高架卫星相匹配,并使用与可缩放的街道级可视化数据库相区别的图片[44],处理文本到3D本地化[16,40,21,42]. 近期的跨模式地貌定位方法还探索了几何对接的多角度投影相似性[12],多视角文本-视觉注册[33],以及语义-焦虑多视角地貌基础模型相接图像和文字相接地貌定位[34]. 这些配方依赖于多视图图像或专用几何锚地,不直接适用于标准文本到图像地识别或其既定基准[13].

blocks.en: Our work focuses on cross-modal text-to-image place recognition, where geographic locations in a street-level image database are retrieved purely from an input natural language description. LaVPR [ 13 ] formalized this setting, showing that adapting vision-language models via LoRA [ 10 ] with Multi-Similarity loss [ 37 ] substantially outperforms zero-shot baselines. However, even after task-specific adaptation these models trail VPR baselines. In this work, we aim to narrow this gap by introducing CrossPlace.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作重点是跨模式文本到图像位置的识别,在街头图像数据库的地理位置完全取自输入的自然语言描述。 LaVPR [13] 将这一设定正式化,表明通过LORA[10]调整具有多相性损失的视觉语言模型[37] 大大超过零射入基线。 然而,即使在针对具体任务的适应之后,这些模型也跟踪VPR基线。 在这项工作中,我们的目标是通过引入CrossPlace来缩小这一差距.

blocks.en: 2.3 Reranking in Place Recognition
blocks.zh: 2.3 在位置识别中重新排位

blocks.en: Two-stage coarse-to-fine pipelines are well established in VPR. Retrieval precision beyond global descriptors is typically enhanced through geometric verification [ 30 ] , local patch matching [ 8 ] , learned keypoint correspondence networks [ 31 ] , or learned candidate re-scorers [ 46 ] . More recently, foundation model approaches like SelaVPR++ [ 24 ] and EffoVPR [ 36 ] demonstrate that adapting token-level features from frozen backbones yields highly efficient two-stage visual retrieval. However, all existing place recognition rerankers operate exclusively on image-to-image correspondences, comparing visual query features directly to database visual representations.
blocks.zh: 两级粗到细管道在VPR中已经建立. 超出全球描述符的检索精度一般通过几何校正[30],局部补丁匹配[8],学习到的关键点通信网络[31],或学习到的候选人再计分[46]来增强. 最近,SelaVPR++ [24]和EffoVPR [36]等基础模型方法表明,从被冻结的骨干上调用信使级特性可产生高度高效的两相视觉检索. 然而,所有已存在的地块识别重排器都完全在图像到图像的通信上运行,直接将可视化的查询功能与数据库可视化的表示进行比较.

blocks.en:
In contrast, two-stage reranking remains completely unexplored in cross-modal place recognition, where existing formulations like LaVPR [ 13 ] rely strictly on single-stage global descriptor retrieval. While fine-grained late-interaction has been explored in general vision-and-language domains [ 26 , 15 ] , those formulations do not transfer straightforwardly to cross-modal place recognition. General text-to-image retrieval methods like TERAN [ 26 ] align words to salient object proposals produced by pre-trained detectors. Such object-centric proposals are computationally prohibitive across city-scale databases and discard the background architectural context and structural textures essential for disambiguating places.
To bridge this gap, we introduce the first lightweight cross-attention reranker tailored for language-to-vision place recognition. Our architecture refines candidate similarity by attending text tokens directly to precomputed visual image patches, capturing fine-grained spatial correspondences with modest latency.
blocks.zh:
相形之下,两阶段的重排在跨模式地识别中仍然完全没有被探索,其中像LaVPR[13]这样的现有配方严格依赖单阶段的全球描述词检索. 虽然在一般的远景和语言领域[26、15]探索了经过细化的后期互动,但这些提法并没有直截了当地转移给跨模式的承认。 TERAN等一般文本到图像检索方法[26]将单词与被预先训练的探测器产生的显著对象建议相配合. 这种以物体为中心的提议在计算上在城市规模数据库中是令人望而却步的,并放弃了背景建筑背景和结构纹理,而这些纹理对混淆地方至关重要。
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了第一个适合语言到视觉位置识别的轻量级交叉注意力调整器。 我们的建筑通过直接参加文字标志来完善候选的相似性,以预设的视觉图像补丁,捕捉稍有潜伏的细纹空间通信.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We formulate the cross-modal place recognition problem ( Section 3.1 ), detail our Stage 1 global retrieval architecture and its alignment scheme ( Section 3.2 ), and present our lightweight token-to-patch reranking module ( Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出跨模式位置识别问题(第3.1节),详细说明我们第一阶段全球检索结构及其调整办法(第3.2节),并介绍我们轻量级的代号到标牌重排模块(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: Let 𝒟 = { I i } i = 1 N \mathcal{D}=\{I_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} denote a database of geo-tagged images and t q t_{q} a natural language query describing a target location. The cross-modal place recognition task retrieves the database image I ∗ ∈ 𝒟 I^{*}\in\mathcal{D} that corresponds to the described location. In a coarse-to-fine framework, retrieval begins by projecting the text query and database images into a shared metric space to select a shortlist of the top- K K candidate images based on global embedding similarity (e.g., cosine similarity). The shortlist is then reranked using fine-grained token-level correspondences to determine the final prediction.

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate CrossPlace on the cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) benchmarks introduced by LaVPR [ 13 ] , which pair the Pittsburgh30k (Pitts30k) [ 35 ] , MSLS-val [ 38 ] , and AmsterTime [ 45 ] datasets with textual query descriptions. To establish a broader evaluation suite, we further apply the description-generation pipeline, available from LaVPR, to two challenging benchmarks: SVOX [ 7 ] , spanning severe weather and illumination shifts, and San Francisco eXtra Large (SF-XL) [ 5 ] , a large-scale urban dataset.

blocks.en: We compare CrossPlace against the prior cross-modal state of the art (LaVPR), adopting LoRA-MS-BLIP [ 13 ] as our primary baseline. In the systematic LaVPR evaluation, which spans zero-shot and PEFT-tuned variants of CLIP, BLIP, SigLIP2, and EVA-CLIP2, LoRA-MS-BLIP achieved the strongest CMPR performance. All fine-tuned LaVPR variants apply LoRA ( r = 64 r{=}64 ) across all linear projections, matching our Stage 1 setup and ensuring that our comparison isolates backbone architecture rather than the adaptation recipe. We evaluate LaVPR using the authors’ publicly released code and checkpoints under our unified protocol. Results on standard benchmarks reproduce those reported in [ 13 ] , and the same checkpoint is evaluated directly on SVOX and SF-XL.

blocks.zh: 5.1 跨模式 位置识别

blocks.en: Table 1 reports Recall@1 across all evaluated datasets. Our Stage 1 global retrieval outperforms LaVPR across every benchmark. On the AmsterTime, MSLS-val, and Pitts30k datasets (’Common’ benchmarks), Stage 1 improves Recall@1 by + 7.8 +7.8 , + 15.8 +15.8 , and + 11.0 +11.0 pp, respectively. Under challenging weather and illumination conditions on SVOX, Stage 1 improves upon LaVPR by + 5.2 +5.2 to + 20.3 +20.3 pp across all settings. Similarly, on the city-scale SF-XL benchmark, Recall@1 rises from 9.5 % 9.5\% to 16.3 % 16.3\% on SF-XL-v1 ( + 6.8 +6.8 pp) and from 19.6 % 19.6\% to 34.6 % 34.6\% on SF-XL-v1 ( + 15.0 +15.0 pp).
blocks.zh: 表1 对所有经评价的数据集召回@1。 我们的第一阶段全球检索比每个基准的LaVPR都要好。 在AmsterTime、MSLS-val和Pitts30k数据集(`Common ' 基准)上,第一阶段分别改进了+7.8+7.8、+15.8+15.8和+11.0 pp。 在SVOX的具有挑战性的天气和照明条件下,第一阶段在LAVPR上改进了5.2+5.2到20.3+20.3页. 同样,在城市规模的SF-XL基准上,Recall@1在SF-XL-v1(+ 6.8+6.8页)上从9.5% 9.5%上升到16.3% 16.3%,在SF-XL-v1(+ 15.0+15.0页)上从19.6% 19.6%上升到34.6% 34.6%.

blocks.en: Adding Stage 2 re-ranking consistently yields further performance gains. On the Common benchmarks, re-ranking improves Recall@1 to 24.0 % 24.0\% , 60.1 % 60.1\% , and 66.4 % 66.4\% on AmsterTime, MSLS-val, and Pitts30k, respectively, yielding overall gains of + 10.8 +10.8 , + 22.1 +22.1 , and + 16.2 +16.2 pp over LaVPR. Paired bootstrap tests across 1,000 resamples confirm that the Stage 2 gains over Stage 1 are statistically significant at all recall levels across all three datasets ( p < 0.05 p{<}0.05 ). On SVOX, CrossPlace achieves total improvements ranging from + 9.7 +9.7 pp under night illumination to + 32.4 +32.4 pp under overcast skies (from 36.8 % 36.8\% to 69.2 % 69.2\% ), demonstrating stability across strong photometric shifts. Similarly, on SF-XL, Stage 2 adds + 6.4 +6.4 and + 7.0 +7.0 pp over Stage 1, more than doubling Recall@1 relative to LaVPR (from 9.5 % 9.5\% to 22.7 % 22.7\% on SF-XL-v1 and 19.6 % 19.6\% to 41.6 % 41.6\% on SF-XL-v2). Qualitatively ( Fig. 2 ), CrossPlace attends to specific landmark cues described in the text query, whereas LaVPR focuses on uninformative background regions (illustrated through Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) analysis [ 32 ] ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Drivers of Performance Gains
blocks.zh: 5.2 业绩收益驱动因素

blocks.en: To understand what drives retrieval accuracy, we isolate the contribution of each architectural component along two main axes: visual encoder granularity and pretraining, text encoder capacity and task alignment. Figure 3 reports Stage 1 Recall@1 across AmsterTime, MSLS-val, and Pitts30k.
blocks.zh: 为了了解什么是驱动检索精度,我们沿着两个主要轴线隔离每个建筑构件的贡献:视觉编码器颗粒和预训,文本编码器容量和任务相接. 图3 第一阶段回顾AmsterTime、MSLS-val和Pitts30k。

blocks.en: Visual token density is the primary driver of retrieval performance, outweighing text encoder capacity. Across every benchmark, upgrading visual granularity with the smaller text encoder (ViT-B/16 + BGE-B) outperforms upgrading text capacity with coarser patches (ViT-B/32 + BGE-L), for example, achieving 43.8 % 43.8\% vs. 37.8 % 37.8\% on MSLS-val and 15.4 % 15.4\% vs. 13.7 % 13.7\% on AmsterTime. Holding both the CLIP initialization and BGE-B fixed, increasing patch granularity from ViT-B/32 ( 49 49 tokens) to ViT-B/16 ( 196 196 tokens) isolates this effect, improving Recall@1 by + 7.7 +7.7 pp on MSLS-val (from 36.1 % 36.1\% to 43.8 % 43.8\% ) and + 4.4 +4.4 pp on Pitts30k (from 48.6 % 48.6\% to 53.0 % 53.0\% ). Switching to DINOv2-B/14 ( 256 256 tokens) with BGE-B, consistently raises Recall@1 further, showing that self-supervised spatial representations reinforce higher patch density even before scaling the text encoder.
blocks.zh: 视觉符号密度是检索性能的主要驱动力,超过了文本编码器容量. 在每个基准中,用更小的文本编码器(ViT-B/16 + BGE-B)来提升视觉颗粒性,比起用相接器补丁(ViT-B/32 + BGE-L)来提升文本容量,例如MSLS-val上的43.8%对37.8%,AmsterTime上的15.4%对13.7%对13.7%。 持有CLIP初始化和BGE-B固定,从Vit-B/32(49个49个令牌)到Vit-B/16(196个196个令牌)的补丁颗粒度增加,隔离了这种效应,在MSLS-val上通过+ 7.7+7.7 pp改进了回召@1(从36.1% 36.1\%到43.8% 43.8\%)和Pitts30k上的+4.4+4.4pp(从48.6% 48.6\%到 53.0% 53.0\%). 与BGE-B切换到DINov2-B/14(256 256个令牌),进一步提高了回召@1,显示自我监督的空间表示甚至在缩放文本编码器之前就加强了较高的补丁密度。

blocks.en: Scaling the text backbone from BGE-B to BGE-L yields consistent improvements across all visual encoders. Paired with DINOv2-B/14, increasing text encoder capacity raises Recall@1 from 18.1 18.1 to 20.6 % 20.6\% on AmsterTime, 49.2 % 49.2\% to 50.3 % 50.3\% on MSLS-val, and 54.7 54.7 to 57.8 % 57.8\% on Pitts30k.
blocks.zh: 从BGE-B到BGE-L的文本主干线的扩展在所有视觉编码器中产生一致的改进. Paired with DINOv2-B/14,增加文本编码器容量将回调@1从18.1 18.1提高到20.6% 在AmsterTime上的20.6%;在MSLS-val上的49.2% 49.2%提高到50.3%;在Pitts30k上的54.7 54.7提高到57.8%。

blocks.en: Progressively fine-tuning BGE-L on place descriptions ( BGE-L ft \text{BGE-L}_{\text{ft}} ) provides further gains across every visual backbone and benchmark. When paired with DINOv2-B/14, task alignment brings Recall@1 to 21.0 % 21.0\% on AmsterTime, 53.8 % 53.8\% on MSLS-val, and 61.2 % 61.2\% on Pitts30k, outperforming the fine-tuned CLIP ViT-B/16 floor baseline by 6.7 6.7 , 10.3 10.3 , and 9.5 9.5 pp, respectively. Across datasets, encoder capacity and domain fine-tuning provide complementary, comparable gains on the text side, with fine-tuning offering the largest boost on MSLS-val ( + 3.5 +3.5 pp) and Pitts30k ( + 3.4 +3.4 pp).
blocks.zh: 在位置描述上逐步微调BGE-L(BGE-L ft\text{BGE-L}_{\text{ft}),为每个视觉主干线和基准提供了进一步的增益. 当与 DINOv2- B/14 配对时, 任务对齐使 AmsterTime 的 Recall@1 达到 21.0% 21.0% , MSLS- val 的 53.8% 53.8% , Pitts30k 的 61.2% 61.2% , 分别以 6.7 , 10.3 10.3 和 9.5 9.5 pp 的优于经过微调的 CLIP ViT- B/16 底线 。 在整个数据集中,编码器容量和域微调在文本侧提供互补,可比较的增益,微调为MSLS-val(+3.5+3.5pp)和Pitts30k(+3.4+3.4pp)提供了最大的助推.

blocks.en: Taken together, these results show that all three design choices contribute additively: higher visual token density and self-supervised pretraining (DINOv2-B/14) provide the primary performance lift, while increasing text encoder capacity and aligning it to place descriptions yield steady, complementary improvements. Our full Stage 1 configuration ( DINOv2-B/14 + BGE-L ft \text{DINOv2-B/14}+\text{BGE-L}_{\text{ft}} ) achieves the highest accuracy across all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这些结果综合起来表明,所有三种设计选择都具有了添加性:视觉符号密度较高和自我监督的预训(DINOv2-B/14)提供了初级性能升力,同时增加了文本编码器的能力并调整了它,以便进行描述,产生稳定,互补的改进. 我们的完整第一阶段配置( DINOv2- B/14 + BGE- L ft\text{ DINOv2- B/14}}\text{ BGE- L}_{\text{ ft}}}) 实现了所有三个基准的最高精度.

blocks.en: To examine whether cross-modal alignment itself remains a limiting factor, we isolate the text representation by evaluating unimodal text-to-text retrieval, where both queries and database places are represented solely by text embeddings. Using the same fine-tuned text encoder, retrieval achieves 67.6 % 67.6\% , 58.1 % 58.1\% , and 22.5 % 22.5\% Recall@1 on Pitts30k, MSLS-val, and AmsterTime, respectively. CrossPlace closely matches, and on MSLS-val and AmsterTime surpasses, these unimodal reference points ( 66.4 % 66.4\% vs. 67.6 % 67.6\% on Pitts30k, 60.1 % 60.1\% vs. 58.1 % 58.1\% on MSLS-val, and 24.0 % 24.0\% vs. 22.5 % 22.5\% on AmsterTime). Our observation that text-to-image retrieval with CrossPlace closely matches unimodal text-to-text retrieval suggests that cross-modal alignment becomes a secondary bottleneck once strong visual representations are paired with fine-grained reranking.
blocks.zh: 为了审查跨模式统一本身是否仍是一个限制因素,我们通过评价单模式文本对文本检索,将文本表述隔离开来,因为单模式文本检索和数据库位置均仅以文本嵌入为代表。 使用同样的微调文本编码器,检索分别实现了67.6%的67.6%,58.1%的58.1%,以及22.5%的22.5%的Pitts30k、MSLS-val和AmsterTime上的回调@1。 交叉 在MSLS-val和AmsterTime上,这些单模式的参考点(Pitts30k上的66.4%对67.6%,MSLS-val上的60.1%对58.1%,AmsterTime上的24.0%对22.5%)。 我们的看法是,使用 CrossPlace 的文本到图像检索与单模式文本到文本检索密切相匹配,这表明,一旦强大的视觉表现与精细的重排对齐,交叉模式的校正就会成为次要瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Alternative Re-Ranking Paradigms
blocks.zh: 5.3 与另类再现范例的比较

blocks.en: To evaluate whether our token-to-patch cross-attention design is necessary, we compare it against alternative re-ranking strategies applied to the exact same Stage 1 candidate shortlists in Table 2 . We benchmark our approach against learned bottleneck queries adopting the Q-Former module from [ 20 ] , token-level contrastive matching following FILIP [ 43 ] which applies ColBERT-style [ 15 ] MaxSim late interaction between text tokens and image patches, and large zero-shot vision-language models including BLIP-2 ITM and Qwen2.5-VL-72B [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们是否有必要进行象征性的交叉注意设计,我们把它与适用于表2中完全相同的第一阶段候选人短名单的其他重新排列战略相比较。 我们参照学习到的瓶颈问题,采用[20]的Q-Former模块,FILIP[43]之后的符号级对比匹配,采用COLBERT风格[ 15] MaxSim在文本符号和图像补丁之间的后期交互,以及包括BLIP-2 ITM和Qun2.5-VL-72B在内的大型零镜头视觉语言模型. [4].

blocks.en: Across all benchmarks, our token-to-patch cross-attention module achieves the highest re-ranking performance, reaching 65.1 % 65.1\% R@1 on Pitts30k, 57.0 % 57.0\% on MSLS-val, and 23.0 % 23.0\% on AmsterTime. The Q-Former baseline reaches 60.2 % 60.2\% on Pitts30k and 55.3 % 55.3\% on MSLS-val despite a comparable parameter budget, while a FILIP-style baseline [ 43 ] with token-level contrastive supervision drops to 37.9 % 37.9\% on Pitts30k, falling below our Stage 1 CrossPlace retriever.
blocks.zh: 在所有基准中,我们的标语到标语交叉调取模块实现了最高的重排性能,在Pitts30k上达到65.1% 65.1\%R@1;在MSLS-val上达到57.0% 57.0\%;在AmsterTime上达到23.0% 23.0\%. Pitts30k的Q-前导基线为60.2%,MSLS-val为55.3%,尽管参数预算相当,而Pitts30k的FILIP式基线为37.9%,低于我们第一阶段的CrossPlace检索器。

blocks.en: Zero-shot vision-language models degrade performance even further on the shortlisted candidates. BLIP-2 ITM [ 20 ] gives 28.6 % 28.6\% R@1 on Pitts30k, while Qwen2.5-VL-72B [ 4 ] reaches 11.5 % 11.5\% on AmsterTime, 37.3 % 37.3\% on MSLS-val, and 48.8 % 48.8\% on Pitts30k, falling below LaVPR across all three benchmarks. Consistent with our encoder-level findings in suppl. section G, where a LoRA-adapted BGE-Small outperforms a frozen BGE-Large, our ≈ 0.6 {\approx}0.6 M-parameter re-ranker trained on in-distribution hard negatives outperforms an unaligned 72B model. Overall, aligning to the place recognition task on hard negatives outweighs model scale for cross-modal re-ranking.
blocks.zh: 零镜头的视觉语言模式使入围候选人的绩效进一步下降。 BLIP-2 ITM [20]在皮特斯30k上给出了28.6%的R@1,而Quen2.5-VL-72B [4]在AmsterTime上达到了11.5%的11.5%;在MSLS-val上达到了37.3%的37.3%;在皮特斯30k上达到了48.8%的48.8%,在所有三个基准上都低于LaVPR. 符合我们编码器层面的发现 G节,一个经过LORA调整的BGE-Small的成绩超过了一个被冻结的BGE-Large,我们的QQ 0.6~相差0.6 M-参数重排训练的分流硬负数比不相通的72B模型要好. 总体而言,与硬负数上的定位识别任务保持一致,超过了跨模式重新排序的模式规模。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Summary. We introduced CrossPlace, a two-stage cross-modal place recognition framework designed to capture fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text. Systematic analysis confirm that visual token density is a primary driver of retrieval accuracy, complemented by text encoder scale and task fine-tuning. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, presenting diverse environmental challenges, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 gains over prior cross-modal baselines, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR.
blocks.zh: 总结. 我们引入了CrossPlace,一个两阶段的跨模式地识别框架,旨在捕捉图像区域和文本之间的精细对应. 系统分析证实可视符号密度是检索精度的主要驱动力,辅以文本编码器尺度和任务微调. CrossPlace通过现有的和新引入的基准,提出了各种不同的环境挑战,实现了两位数的Recall@1比先前的跨模式基线增益,缩小了对单模式文本检索的差距并缩小到单模式VPR。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. A performance gap remains relative to unimodal VPR, which may be narrowed through query-conditioned visual encoding. In addition, re-ranking tradeoffs can be mitigated through compression and quantization methods.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 与单式VPR相比,性能差距依然存在,可以通过查询条件可视化编码来缩小. 此外,再排位取舍可以通过压缩和量化方法来缓解.

blocks.en: LaVPR [ 13 ] is the closest prior method for text-to-image place retrieval. The configuration we compare against adapts BLIP’s text and image encoders with LoRA and trains them with a multi-similarity loss. Because we use the same adaptation and training objective, CrossPlace differs structurally in only two ways: replacing BLIP’s encoders with BGE-Large and DINOv2-B/14, and adding a second stage that re-ranks the shortlist via token-level cross-attention. Critically, our contribution lies not in introducing a complex architecture, but in diagnosing what actually governs CMPR accuracy, showing that fine-grained visual token granularity, dense text capacity, and local token–patch matching resolve a primary bottleneck and narrows the performance gap to unimodal visual place recognition.
blocks.zh: LaVPR [13] 是文本到图像位置检索的最接近的前置方法. 我们对比的配置将 BLIP 的文本和图像编码器与 LORA 相适应, 并训练它们发生多同义性损失 。 因为我们使用相同的适应和训练目标,CrossPlace在结构上只在两个方面有所区别:用BGE-Large和DINov2-B/14取代BLIP的编码器,并增加一个第二阶段,通过象征性的交叉注意对短名单进行重新排序。 关键是,我们的贡献不在于引入一个复杂的架构,而在于诊断什么才是CMPR的准确性,表明精细的视觉标志颗粒性、密集的文本容量以及本地标志-patch匹配解决了主要瓶颈,并将性能差距缩小到单模式视觉位置识别。

blocks.en:

multi-similarity loss, denoted LoRA-MS) and matched by cosine
similarity. Since no cross-modal alignment is involved, it shows how
well the text encoder alone can separate places. The gap between it

blocks.en: G Text-to-Text Retrieval Diagnostic
blocks.zh: G 文本对文本检索诊断

blocks.en: Table 10 isolates the effect of the modality gap by comparing cross-modal (text-to-image) retrieval against a uni-modal (text-to-text) diagnostic reference in which both queries and database entries are textual descriptions. Within the uni-modal experiments, task adaptation outweighs model scale. On Pitts30k, full LoRA adaptation lifts BGE-Large from 36.5 % 36.5\% (frozen) to 67.6 % 67.6\% Recall@1, whereas Learned Language Pooling (LLP) [ 13 ] alone reaches only 46.8 % 46.8\% . Adapting all linear layers also proves more effective than increasing rank: all-linear LoRA at r = 16 r{=}16 ( 64.7 % 64.7\% ) outperforms QV LoRA at r = 64 r{=}64 ( 63.2 % 63.2\% ). Furthermore, a fully adapted BGE-Small ( 61.5 % 61.5\% R@1), despite being roughly 10 × 10\times smaller, substantially outperforms frozen BGE-Large ( 36.5 % 36.5\% ) and even surpasses BGE-Large adapted with QV LoRA at r = 16 r{=}16 ( 57.5 % 57.5\% ). Across all three datasets, the strongest uni-modal configuration (BGE-Large with all-linear LoRA at r = 64 r{=}64 ) establishes a text-only reference of 22.5 % 22.5\% , 58.1 % 58.1\% , and 67.6 % 67.6\% R@1 on AmsterTime, MSLS-val, and Pitts30k, respectively, with substantial gains compared to the frozen and LLP configurations.
blocks.zh: 表10通过比较跨模式(文本到图像)检索与单模式(文本到文本)诊断参考,将查询和数据库条目均为文字描述,从而分离出模式差距的影响. 在单式试验中,任务适应大于模型规模。 在Pitts30k上,完全的LORA适应将BGE-Large从36.5% (被冻)升至67.6% (67.6%) recall@1,而学习语言集合(LLP)[13]单是达到46.8% 46.8\%. 适应所有线性地层也证明比提高分级更有效: 此外,一个完全适应的BGE-Small(61.5% 6.5 % R@1)尽管大约小于10×10分,但大大超过冻结的BGE-Large(36.5% 36.5 % ),甚至超过了QV LORA(64% 64.7 % ) 的QV LORA(16 r r * ) 。 在所有3个数据集中,最强的单式配置(BGE-Large with all-linear LoRA at r = 64 r * 1)都建立了仅以文本为22.5% = 22.5 % 、58.1% 58.1 % 和67.6% 67.6 % R@1 at Amster Time、MSLS-val和 Pitts30k为例的参考,与冻结和 LLP配置相比,分别取得了巨大的收益。

blocks.en:
Comparing the cross-modal block against this uni-modal reference shows how effectively CrossPlace bridges the modality gap. While LaVPR [ 13 ] trails the best text-to-text model by 9.3 9.3 , 20.1 20.1 , and 17.4 17.4 pp Recall@1 on Amstertime, MSLS-val and Pitts30k, respectively, CrossPlace closes most of this margin in Stage 1 ( 21.0 % 21.0\% , 53.8 % 53.8\% , and 61.2 % 61.2\% R@1) and eliminates it with Stage 2 re-ranking, surpassing the text-to-text reference on AmsterTime ( 24.0 % 24.0\% vs. 22.5 % 22.5\% ) and MSLS-val ( 60.1 % 60.1\% vs. 58.1 % 58.1\% ) while closely matching it on Pitts30k ( 66.4 % 66.4\% vs. 67.6 % 67.6\% ).
CrossPlace’s near-parity with pure text-to-text matching suggests that when combining dense visual tokens, strong adapted text representations, and local cross-modal matching, cross-modal alignment becomes a secondary limiting factor rather than the primary bottleneck.
blocks.zh:
将跨模式区块与这种单模式的参照相比较,可以看出跨模式如何有效 设置模式间隙。 LaVPR [13] 分别以 9.3 9.3, 20.1 20.1 和 17.4 17.4 pp 在 Amstertime, MSLS-val 和 Pitts30k 上的回想@1 追踪最佳文本对文本模式 在第一阶段(21.0% 21.0\%、53.8% 53.8\%和61.2% 61.2\% R@1)中将这一比值关闭,并随着第二阶段的重新排序而取消,超过了AmsterTime上的文本对文本参考(24.0% 24.0\%对22.5% 22.5\%)和MSLS-val(60.1% 60.1\%对58.1% 58.1\%),同时在Pitts30k上密切匹配(66.4% 66.4\%对67.6\%)。
CrossPlace与纯文本对等的近等表示,当结合密集的视觉符号,强而易之的文字表现,以及本地的跨模式相配时,跨模式相配会成为次要的限制因素,而不是主要瓶颈.
